intro: I run the messy middle of enterprise software programs: scoping the work, aligning finance and IT, keeping delivery honest, and getting the system into production without the usual last-mile stall.

At HighRadius I owned end-to-end SaaS implementations for Fortune 500 clients — lifting automation from 42% to 70% on key workflows and recovering a high-risk Cash Application program from red to green in under a month.
At Purdue I'm completing an MS in Business Analytics and Information Management, with a banking practicum at Community First Bank focused on operational bottlenecks and data-backed automation.
